description: Every assessment contract fixture, the schema it is checked against and the expected verdict. expect=valid must validate. For the request schema the Go decoder (assesswire.DecodeAssessmentRequest) also applies server normalisation, whose refusals use the keywords normalisation, format and public_address. response_mode, when set, names the view a response fixture is: assesswire.ModeViolations must accept a valid one and report `rule` for a semantic_invalid one. expect=invalid must fail schema validation, and the set of top-level (keyword, JSON pointer) errors must equal `errors` plus `also` under python-jsonschema, and jsonschema-rs must reach the same valid/invalid verdict, where `also` lists errors intrinsic to the same bad value (an over-long value that also breaks its pattern). expect=semantic_invalid is schema-valid and runtime/contracts/the Go contract implementation.semantic_violations (history_violations for a page) must report `rule`. A schema of the form identity.openapi.json#/... names a schema inside the OpenAPI document. tests/contracts/test_the Go contract implementation.py enforces all of this and that every file here is listed.
